title: Tech Saturn Vol. 1/1996: Yatchimatta!
native_title: ＴＥＣＨ ＳＡＴＵＲＮ Ｖｏｌ．１／１９９６ やっちまった！
overview: Tech Saturn Vol. 1/1996 is the Sega Saturn CD-ROM that came packed in a sleeve inside that issue of Tech Saturn, ASCII's Saturn magazine. Each issue's disc mixed trial versions of Saturn games with original content made by the magazine's own staff.
